title: A cover picked for one replacement video is kept for the next video or the original
trigger: Edit a video message: Replace with video X, Edit Cover, then replace with video Y or press Clear replacement, then Save.
effect: media_edit.cover is never cleared when the replacement changes (copy_inline_text.rs:60-84 only resets video_extras for a different path); effective_cover only checks that a video applies, so the old cover is sent with Y, or with the original video after the replacement is cleared.
fix: Put cover and extras inside EditMediaReplacement so replacing or clearing it replaces them whole.

title: Disk recovering drains disk_paused then aborts with ? on the first toggle error
trigger: Disk was Low and paused several downloads; disk becomes Healthy while one toggleDownloadIsPaused send fails
effect: disk_paused.drain() and forget_disk_pause already ran for all ids, so the downloads after the failing one stay paused and are never resumed by the disk logic; save_disk_pauses_if_changed is skipped too
fix: Remove each id from disk_paused only after its resume was sent; keep going or leave the rest in the set on error

title: set_default_reaction is optimistic and nothing rolls it back
trigger: Settings, Quick reaction: pick a reaction; TDLib answers an error (e.g. not premium for custom emoji)
effect: session.stickers.default_reaction keeps the failed choice and shows it as set; SetDefaultReactionType has no error arm anywhere (grep only finds purpose.rs)
fix: Store the previous value on the pending request (RequestRollback) like toggle_sign_messages does

title: ffprobe/ffmpeg run synchronously on the UI thread when the snapshot was not prepared
trigger: Send media whose background preparation has not finished (or edit with a replacement video: edit.rs:86 probe_local_video)
effect: media_send_path/video_probe/video_note/local_animation fall back to send_path_for / probe_local_video / probe_with_ffprobe / write_video_note_thumbnail; doc comment itself says 'can wait on ffmpeg'. UI freeze for large videos
fix: Make unprepared snapshots a not-ready stage that waits for the background job instead of computing inline

title: fetch_chat_photos re-sends the full-info request every call while chat_current_photos stays empty
trigger: Open the photo viewer for a chat whose full-info answer errors or has no photo.
effect: chat_current_photos is only filled by a successful answer, so each open (and any retry) sends getSupergroupFullInfo / getBasicGroupFullInfo again; chat_photo_history is Loading-keyed but current photo has no stage.
fix: Fetch<Option<Photo>> for the current photo.

title: An OS media key pressed while nothing plays is queued and replayed on the next track
trigger: Play a voice note or song, let it end (or close the bar), press the media key or playerctl play-pause (macOS remote commands and MPRIS stay registered), then start another voice note minutes later
effect: The queued Toggle or Pause lands on the first playback tick and pauses or stops the new track at once; a queued Next skips
fix: Drop commands when no player owns the session (take_commands in the inactive branch of the playback tick, or stamp each command with the time and ignore old ones); keep a CommandQueue owned by the active player.

title: A failed searchFileDownloads for disk-paused downloads is never handled, so the once-per-session flag stays set
trigger: Disk gets low and downloads are paused and saved; restart Quill on a healthy disk; the startup searchFileDownloads (SearchDiskPausedDownloads) answers with a TDLib error (or the pending request is settled without an answer).
effect: disk_resume_searched stays true (it is reset only when the synchronous send fails in connect/disk_paused.rs), disk_search_keys stays filled, so the paused downloads are never resumed until the next restart; no error is shown.
fix: Make the search one enum (NotAsked, Asked{request, keys}, Done) and add an error arm in apply_media_error that returns it to NotAsked (or Done) when the request id matches.

title: A late Gifts page for another chat overwrites the open gallery's Gifts next_offset
trigger: Open the shared media gallery of user A on the Gifts tab, then before its receivedGifts page lands open the profile gallery of user B (or another channel); A's page lands after B's first page.
effect: accept_profile rejects A's items (chat mismatch), but apply_profile_gifts writes page.next_offset into the in-place gallery's Gifts tab unconditionally, so B's tab pages on with A's offset: Load more in B fetches from the wrong offset (skipped or repeated gifts, or the list ends early).
fix: Move next_offset into accept_profile behind the same chat check (or carry the gallery generation on GetProfileGifts like the message tabs) so a rejected page writes nothing.

title: Clips keep being assigned to a sticker worker that has ended
trigger: A sticker worker or opener thread ends (a panic in decode or packing caught by spawn_guarded).
effect: WorkerEnd only sets worker_gone, which wait_idle reads; open() still picks workers from the fixed `live` list, so new clips land on the dead worker and stay Opening with busy set forever, and clips it owned never get frames. Stickers and custom emoji on that worker stay blank until restart.
fix: Track each worker's liveness in State (Running | Gone) and, when one ends, mark its clips Failed (or reassign them) and leave it out of open()'s choice.

title: Streaming rows hash changes every render for empty or rich drafts
trigger: Bot sends a draft with no text yet (Thinking placeholder) or a RichMessage draft in the open chat
effect: stream_rows_hash treats revealing = reveal.draft_id != draft.draft_id; StreamReveal::advance (which sets draft_id) runs only for non-empty Text drafts, so for an empty or Rich draft revealing stays true and the hash carries a fresh nanosecond tick each call: the history rows are rebuilt on every frame that renders for the whole life of the draft
fix: Derive 'revealing' from the draft content (Text with shown<total) not from draft_id equality, or have StreamReveal track the draft for every content kind

title: The decoded image for Edit Image opens the editor without checking that the message edit it was started for is still the current one
trigger: While editing photo message A choose Edit Media > Edit Image on a large photo, then cancel the edit or start editing another message before the decode ends. The callback only tests viewer.photo_editor.is_none(). PhotoEditor::for_message_edit carries no edit key, and save_photo_editor reads edited_message() at Done, not at open.
effect: An editor of A's pixels opens over no edit (Done is dropped silently) or over message B's edit, where A's picture is staged as B's replacement.
fix: Carry the (chat, message) of the edit in EditorPurpose::MessageEdit and compare it in the decode callback and at Done.

title: The picked video cover is applied to whatever edit is pending when the file dialog returns
trigger: Choose Edit Media > Edit Cover for video message A, leave the native file dialog open, cancel the edit and start editing video message B (or switch chats), then pick a file.
effect: set_edit_cover stages the cover on B's edit (or does nothing without a note after a chat switch), so B is saved with A's cover.
fix: Capture edited_message() when the picker starts and apply the result only if it is still the pending edit.

title: HDR JPEG XL decode holds up to three full-size float copies at once (about 2.3 GB at the 48 Mpx cap)
trigger: On Windows, open a 40+ megapixel HDR JPEG XL in the media viewer.
effect: samples (f32 x channels), the pixels Vec<[f32;4]> and then the resize buffer in scaled() are alive together; with MAX_PIXELS = 2 x HDR_MAX_PIXELS this can exhaust memory in the background job and abort the app (allocation failure is not catchable by contained()).
fix: Convert row by row from the stream into the final buffer (or downscale during conversion) and cap MAX_PIXELS at the memory the three copies need, returning Ok(None) (SDR) above it.

title: Headroom poll notifies every second forever once edr_lost is set on an HDR-capable screen
trigger: Open an HDR picture on a display with EDR headroom where the renderer cannot build its float pipelines (edr_lost = true), and leave the viewer open.
effect: viewer_hdr_element stores hdr.headroom = SDR.effective() = 1.0 while edr_lost, but the poll compares super::headroom(window).effective() (e.g. 2.0+) against that 1.0, sees 'changed' every tick and calls cx.notify(): a full app redraw 10 times a second for the first second and once a second after, for as long as the viewer is open.
fix: Compare against the same value the draw uses (the display headroom unless edr_lost, then SDR), computed in one function shared by draw and poll, or skip the headroom comparison when edr_lost.

title: A chat window's media viewer draws HDR frames but never switches its window to extended range
trigger: Open a chat in its own window, open an HDR picture file (gain-map JPEG / HEIC) in that window's media viewer (ViewerPart::Inline draws viewer_hdr_element via overlay.rs).
effect: sync_viewer_hdr runs only from the main window's render (app_render/mod.rs), so the chat window's layer stays 8-bit while the surface frame is tone-mapped for the display headroom: the picture is drawn dim/clipped, yet the badge says 'HDR shown' because edr_on is never true and edr_lost is therefore never detected.
fix: Run the EDR sync in the per-window upkeep (window_upkeep.rs) for whichever window's ViewerUi is in place, with the EDR mode stored per window slot.

title: A click demand outlives a row that never renders it and fires later
trigger: Click a downloaded round video, then switch chat before the row renders; return later
effect: The round video starts with sound from the start unprompted (forget() only runs for dropped slots, frame_start leaves do not clear on_demand)
fix: Expire the demand when its window's history pass ends (frame_start/leave) or tie it to the visit it was asked in

title: start_demand consumed in render even when toggle_sound returns false, so the click is lost
trigger: Click a round video the moment its player opens, before it can toggle sound
effect: Next frame start_demand is false and the player is muted so end_demand drops the demand: nothing plays with sound, no feedback
fix: Make the demand a stage the player advances (Asked -> Playing) and only leave Asked when sound actually started; do not mutate it from render

title: Account switch leaves the GIF panel gate and status-choices gate open on the outgoing session
trigger: Open the composer panel on its GIFs tab (or the emoji status selector), then switch to another account from the account list.
effect: PickerUi's Farewell is empty and leave_for_background only deselects the chat, so the retired session keeps stickers.gifs.open (and emoji.status_open) true. The background client keeps downloading GIF panel files and running GIF searches (sync_shown_media, maybe_search_gifs) until the user switches back, where sync_gif_downloads closes it.
fix: Give PickerUi a real Farewell that calls close_gif_panel and close_emoji_status_choices on the client being left, or make the gate a function of the on-screen panel mode only.

title: Closing the editor from Stickers mode leaves the mask strip wanted
trigger: Open the photo editor, press Stickers (sets masks.strip_wanted), then Cancel or Done, or send the tray so the editor is dropped, or lock/switch account.
effect: load_editor_masks sets session.stickers.masks.strip_wanted; release_editor_masks runs only when another mode button is pressed. close_photo_editor, save_photo_editor and the composer_sends drop never call it, so pump_masks keeps loading mask sets after every envelope with nothing on screen, and the flag stays on the account's session after a switch.
fix: Release the strip from the editor's drop (a guard value held while Stickers mode is active) rather than from the mode button.

title: Removing or reordering a saved track reports success before (and whatever) the driver result; errors are discarded
trigger: On your own Playlist page choose Delete on a track and confirm while the request cannot be sent (connection lost, client not ready); or drag a track to reorder.
effect: 'Saved music removed' toast shows immediately, remove_profile_audio_track/move_profile_audio_track Err is dropped with `let _`, and the track stays; no error is ever shown.
fix: Set the toast from the Result (Ok -> removed, Err -> error note) as the other pin/poll starters do, and carry a request id so a later failure from TDLib can surface.

title: A channel photo gallery click that fails to send waits forever with no message
trigger: Click a group or channel avatar while the chats path is not active (fetch_chat_photos returns Err, ignored by let _).
effect: open_peer_photos treats PhotoOwner::Chat as sent, calls wait_for_profile_gallery, nothing is requested and no Failed entry exists, so the click does nothing and pending_profile_gallery stays set until another click replaces it (and may open late if photos arrive for it).
fix: Use the fetch_chat_photos result like the User branch: on Err show the note and do not set the pending gallery; clear the pending gallery on request end.

title: Edit contact, birthday, personal channel, photo and share-contact boxes close and toast success on enqueue, not on the answer
trigger: Save an edited contact or birthday, pick a personal channel, confirm a personal photo, or send a shared contact while Telegram rejects the request (flood, privacy, invalid value).
effect: The box closes and shows 'Contact saved' / 'Birthday saved' at once; a server error has no place to show, so the user sees success and the old value reappears.
fix: ProfileDialog variants carry a Saving stage that closes on the answer and shows the error in the box on failure.

title: Secret-chat layer check for round video uses the main window's open chat
trigger: Chat window on an old-layer secret chat, main window on a normal chat: record a video note in the chat window
effect: Video note allowed to an old-layer secret chat (or blocked wrongly in the opposite case)
fix: Use viewed_chat() in open_secret_chat_peer_layer.

title: 'Play once' offered by the main window's chat kind, not the recording window's chat
trigger: Main window on a private chat, chat window on a group; record a voice note in the group, toggle Play once, send (send_finished_voice applies recording.once without re-checking chat kind)
effect: Group voice note sent as one-time message / refused, or the toggle missing in a private chat window when main has a group open
fix: Compute once_allowed from the capture's origin chat and re-check it at send time.

title: Recording chat action (recording voice/video) goes to the main window's open chat, not the recording's chat window
trigger: Start a voice note in a chat window for chat B while the main window shows chat A
effect: Chat A's members see 'recording voice message' while the user records in B; B shows none; cancels when main has no chat open
fix: Pass the recording's origin chat (Capture::origin chat) to sync_voice_recording/sync_video_note_recording instead of reading session.open_chat.

title: Gallery scroll position and paging mark survive close and reopen of the same chat
trigger: Open the shared-media gallery of chat A, scroll the Media (or Files) tab down, press the close button, open it again for A. close() clears the tabs and restamps them, but PageKey (chat, anchor_day, query) is unchanged and nothing drew another page in between.
effect: The freshly loaded first page opens at the old scroll offset (or at its end, firing the Load more row at once); a list tab's Asked still holds the old length, so the first automatic page is skipped until the reader scrolls.
fix: Add the tab's generation stamp (SharedMediaTabState::generation) to PageKey so a cleared tab is a new page.

title: A row ticked before its message properties arrive can stay unable to forward or delete
trigger: Hover a gallery row and tick it at once, then move to another row. The tick stores allow-nothing (SelectedMedia::from_actions(None)); the answer lands in the single shared messages.message_menu_actions slot, refresh_from_answer runs only on later hover events, and the next row's request overwrites the slot.
effect: Forward and Delete in the selection bar stay disabled for the whole group until that row is unticked and ticked again.
fix: Send a properties request per ticked message keyed by message id and apply each answer to its selection entry, instead of reading one shared slot on hover.

title: Gallery row menu acts on the gallery chat at click time, not the chat the menu was built for
trigger: Right click a gallery row (menu captures message_id and file only), then change the gallery chat before choosing an item (keyboard chat switch, notification click). shared_media_menu_action reads session.media.shared_media.chat_id when the item is clicked.
effect: Forward runs begin_forward_one(new chat, old message id), and ids collide across private chats and basic groups, so a different message can be forwarded. Delete is gated by the actions slot and mostly refused.
fix: Capture an AccountChat/ChatMessage owner key in the menu closure and drop the action when it no longer equals the open gallery chat.

title: Media spoiler tile (60 frames of 3000 specks) is built inside paint on the UI thread and rebuilt after every 3 s idle release
trigger: Scroll to a chat with a spoiler photo, scroll away for 3+ s, scroll back.
effect: Frame hitch of tens of ms (about 4.5M speck stamps and 16 MB allocation) each time.
fix: Build off-thread into a Loading/Ready tile, and release only under memory pressure.

title: Export writes a workbook that silently lacks graphs that are still loading or failed, and then reports success
trigger: Open channel statistics while async graphs (mute graph etc.) are loading or one failed, press Export to File.
effect: File saved with missing sheets; the toast says the export is done.
fix: Refuse (or warn) while any async graph of the page is Loading or Failed.

title: The pump redraws the whole app on every drained batch, not only for a first frame
trigger: Any animated sticker or emoji playing
effect: The doc says it redraws when a clip opened or its first frame is ready, but drain()'s first-frame result is ignored and cx.notify() runs for every worker wake, so layered emoji (meant to avoid rebuilding slices) still rebuild the app per decoded frame
fix: Notify only when drain() returned true

title: A finished old encode clears the encoding handle of a newer encode
trigger: Press Done on a video sticker, cancel the box (cancel flag only stops between quality steps), open Create Sticker again and press Done before the first encode returns
effect: The old continuation sets sticker_box.encoding = None unconditionally; the new encode then finds encoding None, so current is false and its result is dropped. Done is enabled again, the box stays open, nothing is uploaded and the new encode can no longer be cancelled
fix: Make encoding an enum Idle|Encoding{token,cancel} and clear it only when the finishing job's token still matches

title: A chosen video that fails to download leaves pending_video set with no progress or error
trigger: In Adapt from a Sticker, pick a WEBM (or a saved GIF) that is not downloaded and let the download fail or the app be offline
effect: The chooser closed, nothing is shown, no editor ever opens; pending_video stays until the set box closes. Without a live driver it never resolves
fix: Add a Downloading stage that shows progress and has an error exit when the file's download ends without a path

title: A failed encode of a tray or edit-box video leaves the editor with no player for good
trigger: Attach a video, open Edit Video, trim it so it needs encoding, press Done; the ffmpeg encode fails (for example the disk is full or the codec is refused).
effect: finish_video_editor sets editor.player = None before encoding; the Err arm only clears busy and sets the note. start_video_editor_player runs only from video_editor_probed, so the editor stays open showing a still picture: the loop does not play, a click on the picture does not pause or resume (toggle_video_editor_pause needs a player), and the playhead does not move. The user has to cancel and reopen the editor.
fix: Make the editor's stage one enum (Reading, Unreadable, Ready { player }, Encoding { serial }), with the player inside Ready. The encode's error arm then goes back to Ready and reopens the player. The avatar path in profile_photo_sources/video.rs already keeps the player.

title: still_busy sticks after a failed tray encode, so the cover still and the rotate/flip preview never update again
trigger: Open Edit Video on a tray video and drag the cover head, which starts a still cut. Press Done (Enter) before the cut lands, then let the encode fail.
effect: Done bumps editor.serial. The in-flight cut's answer no longer matches the serial, so it is dropped before still_busy = false runs. The encode's Err arm (video_editor.rs:504-509) does not clear still_busy, unlike the avatar path (profile_photo_sources/video.rs:111). Every later refresh_video_preview only stores still_wanted and returns, so the cover bubble, the still and the turned/mirrored preview stay frozen until the editor is reopened.
fix: Make the still cutter one value, enum StillCut { Idle, Cutting { serial, next: Option<i64> } }, matched by its own token instead of the editor-wide serial, so an encode does not orphan it. At minimum, clear still_busy in the tray/edit Err arm as the avatar path does.

title: Voice encoder thread failure mid-recording is never surfaced: the bar keeps recording and the preview waits forever
trigger: Start a voice note; while recording, the encoder's push/pause fails (disk full, the capture folder removed, an Opus encode error). Keep talking, press Pause, then press the preview Play button; finally press Send.
effect: VoiceCapture::failure only reads the mic error slot and the zero-samples idle check, never whether the worker thread already returned Err. The timer keeps counting and the bars freeze; Pause never sets Control::flushed, so toggle_record_preview shows 'Getting the recording ready' on every press forever; only Send reports the error, after which the whole recording is deleted.
fix: Let failure() also report a finished worker (JoinHandle::is_finished, or an encoder error slot the thread writes before returning), so check_recording ends the recording with the reason at once.
